title: GTA 6 Official Album Announced with Pre-Orders Live
description: Rockstar Games has announced the official GTA 6 album via Atlantic Records, featuring CD and vinyl options alongside streaming pre-saves.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Official Album Announced and Available for Pre-Order

As anticipation continues to build around the release of *GTA 6*, Rockstar Games has given fans a major new update regarding the game's musical companion. According to a recent report by gaming outlet Push Square, the official *GTA 6* album has officially been announced, with pre-orders now live through Atlantic Records.

### Exploring Pre-Order and Format Options

Music collectors and fans of physical media have plenty of options to choose from with this official release. Via the official site, players and audiophiles can pre-purchase the album in multiple physical formats:

* **CD Format**: A classic choice for digital audio enthusiasts and physical collectors.
* **Standard Vinyl Edition**: Perfect for those who appreciate the warm, analog sound and aesthetic of vinyl records.
* **Limited Edition Vinyl**: A special, limited-run option designed for dedicated collectors looking for unique packaging and presentation.

In addition to physical formats, digital-first fans are not left behind. The album is currently available for pre-save on major music streaming services, including Apple Music and Spotify, ensuring that listeners can access the tracks the moment they drop.

### The Cultural Significance of Music in GTA

Music has always been the heartbeat of the *Grand Theft Auto* franchise. From iconic fictional radio stations to meticulously curated licensed soundtracks, Rockstar Games has consistently set the gold standard for audio design in open-world gaming. The announcement of a dedicated official album highlights how crucial music is to setting the tone, atmosphere, and cultural landscape of the upcoming title.

While several tracks have already been revealed through the initial announcements, fans are eagerly looking forward to full tracklist details as the release window approaches. 

### Editor's Take
Rockstar Games understands better than anyone how to build hype across all entertainment mediums. Announcing the official album and launching pre-orders well ahead of time proves that *GTA 6* is more than just a video game—it is an expansive cultural event. For both die-hard collectors and casual fans, securing a copy of this vinyl or CD feels like an essential piece of the experience.
